history.recommendation_text: The Board also recommends that the Administration continue its efforts to implement adequate and effective management, as well as strengthen communication with contractors and stakeholders to ensure completion within the updated project schedule.
history.administration_response: For design document coordination between the lead architect, Architectus & Conrad Gargett, and the Africa Hall project team, a document management platform, Newforma, has been utilized by the architect since the inception of the project. Newforma allows the transfer and recording of correspondence without limitation of file types and sizes, which includes design drawings, reports, pictures, invoices, and so on. For the main construction work of the Africa Hall renovation project, a real-time document management platform, Aconex, has been utilized since 2023. Aconex allows the whole project team, which includes the lead architect, the construction contractor and its sub-contractors, and the Africa Hall project team, to exchange, record and store all project correspondence, namely technical submittals review and approval, variation review, contractual notification and instructions, and so on. As of December 2023, there are over 2,500 documents recorded in Aconex. Project management controls have also been further strengthened, that is, written updates on significant project-related developments are submitted to the project Advisory Board, which has enhanced the tracking of progress, and action points from the meetings are followed through. Stakeholder meetings are held to assess the schedule progress.
history.board_assessment: Given that the project management controls have been further strengthened, the Board considers this recommendation to be implemented.
